description: This file defines the DynamicPageCacheSubscriber class, which implements event-driven caching logic for Drupal's dynamic page cache. It manages cache hits and misses by subscribing to kernel request and response events, utilizing cache policies, cache contexts, and cacheability metadata to optimize page caching behavior.

classes.name: DynamicPageCacheSubscriber
classes.description: Implements an event subscriber for managing Drupal's dynamic page cache, handling cache hits and misses based on request and response policies, cacheability metadata, and cache contexts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DynamicPageCacheSubscriber with cache policies, cache interface, cache contexts manager, and renderer configuration.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming requests to determine if a cached response can be served, setting the response headers accordingly.

methods.name: onResponse
methods.description: Processes outgoing responses to cache cacheable responses or mark responses as uncacheable based on policies and cacheability metadata.

methods.name: shouldCacheResponse
methods.description: Determines if a response should be cached based on cacheability metadata, cache max-age, contexts, and tags.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Specifies the kernel events (request and response) to which this class subscribes, with their respective priorities.
